svg.title: Who must mark what
svg.desc: Shadow 06 figure F7. Exact plotted values are encoded on marks.

g.data-value: Labelling Measures and later CAC programmes
AI Act Art. 50 (as amended by Reg. 2026/1744)

providers: machine-readable marking (exceptions incl. assistive standard editing). Deployers: disclose deepfakes (adapted for evidently artistic, creative or satirical work); disclose AI-generated text published to inform the public on matters of public interest, unless it has undergone human review or editorial control AND a person holds editorial responsibility. That exception applies only to the text disclosure, not to deepfakes or provider marking
applicable from 2 Aug 2026; legacy systems by 2 Dec 2026
record located; full text not retrieved
record located; operative text not verified
marking and notice, differentiated by output type
AI Transparency Act as amended (SB 1000; AB 853; AB 2713)
providers (no user threshold); covered platforms from 2027
latent disclosure; free disclosure verification tool
operative 2 Aug 2026; platforms from 1 Jan 2027; capture devices from 2028
providers: machine-readable marking; deployers: disclosure (Art. 11 conditions)
Revised Public Offices Election Act (Law No. 58)
Prohibition of realistic but false candidate depictions
prohibited during election period (a label does not exempt)
UAE Media Council (issuer of the statement; since replaced by the National Media Authority)
AI depictions of national symbols and public figures
prior official approval for AI depictions of national symbols and public figures; AI misuse to spread misinformation, incite hatred or defame others subject to the media violations regulation
General Policy for the Use of AI
general AI policy; marking clauses not verified

svg.text: Instruments we located and verified. A comparison of specified obligations, not a ranking of countries' overall AI regulation.
Grey rows: official texts located but not cleared for detailed description; only metadata is shown.
United Kingdom: a January 2026 House of Commons Library briefing stated that no UK legislation requires AI-generated content to be labelled.
Official instruments and issuer publications named in the Source column.
